sigil.name: Fortune's Wheel
sigil.text: A long gaming hall with a gilded wheel mounted on its roof. Striped awnings and open doors line the front.

sigil.name: Funicular
sigil.text: A tavern on wheels that seems to teeter on the edge of Sigil. Every once in a while it rolls by, or you can spot it across the ring.

sigil.name: Secret Door Safe House
sigil.text: A plain door in a plain wall. It is rarely in the same wall twice.

sigil.name: Barracks
sigil.text: A walled, fortress-like compound with two tall towers, the entrance in the shape of two clasping hands. Soldiers in matching armor come and go through its gates.

sigil.name: High Courts
sigil.text: A grand hall of pale stone and tall spires where the city's disputes are argued and judged.

sigil.name: Prison
sigil.text: A great domed tower ringed with spikes and dark stone, where the city keeps its criminals and lawbreakers.

sigil.name: Heart's Fire
sigil.text: A domed hall with a slender bell tower beside it.  It rings every peak and is accompanied by flare at the top of the bell tower.

sigil.name: Infinite Well
sigil.text: A tall, spired structure standing on thin legs, with a pale clearing around it.  Below the tower is an opposite hole that leads to only darkness.

sigil.name: Wandering Flame guild hall
sigil.text: A stone and wooden structure with offices, bedchambers, a common room, and a stage always occupied by a bard.

sigil.name: Red Sensation Museum of Art
sigil.text: A tall, narrow gallery of oxblood stone with no windows and a single entrance.

sigil.name: Baatorian Embassy
sigil.text: A cold black-stone building hung with red banners, with one guarded door.

sigil.name: Mirrored Museums
sigil.text: Two museums face opposite each on the same block: Madam Buffont's House of Hair, and Lady Tryst's Display of Nails. All day admission is two silver per side; including hand stamp.

sigil.name: Armory
sigil.text: A great angular fortress of steel-gray plates and tall windows covered in razorvine, hung with gold banners.

sigil.name: Great Foundry
sigil.text: A vast, dirty, smoking cluster of squat buildings and chimneys, its furnaces and hammers never unused.

sigil.name: Shattered Temple
sigil.text: A great temple that may have once been beautiful.  Now glassless windows stare out and broken arches rise like ribs from the rubble, covered in moss.

sigil.name: Ubiquitous Wayfarer
sigil.text: A narrow unimpressive brick building, tucked among crooked lanes.  Offering standard food, standard ale.

sigil.name: Red Lantern
sigil.text: A tavern of darkwood polished stone with a red lantern hung over the door.  The menu is always in infernal and so is the food.

sigil.name: Parted Veil
sigil.text: A bookshop with a striped awning and flags over the door, known for its maze-like aisles and whispering tomes.

sigil.name: Face of Gith
sigil.text: A githzerai meeting place where local bashers come to drink.  Its faded but still slightly reflective metal exterior is in the shape of a giant githzerai face.

sigil.name: Bones of the Night
sigil.text: A place of pale stone, now ruined at the edge of the ward.  An occasional lamplight emanates from the site.

sigil.name: Five Portals Inn
sigil.text: A crowded inn named for the connections to the Elemental Planes.  Water flows freely here, fire burns in its hearth, light emits from its shades, unmentionables, and a breeze summoned with coin. A stable stands tucked in behind.

sigil.name: Mortuary
sigil.text: A sprawling gray-green hall of domes and spires, home of the Dustmen. Anyone may come to pay respects to the dead, or dispose of them.

sigil.name: Gatehouse
sigil.text: A tiered tower of terraces and spires, the Bleak Cabal's asylum.  Faces peek out from the tiny windows.

sigil.name: The Ditch
sigil.text: A wide, foul channel of slow moving water cutting through the Hive, crossed by a few bridges.

sigil.name: Gatehouse Night Market
sigil.text: A market that sets up in the shadow of the Gatehouse after dark.  Don’t ask for names, don’t ask for change, and don’t ask where it came from.

sigil.name: Fell's Tattoos
sigil.text: A tattoo shop in a rounded building with an interestingly moving sign and also interestingly moving tattoos.

sigil.name: Smoldering Corpse Bar
sigil.text: A low, domed bar whose chimneys never stop smoking and whose blood stained metal tables are never empty.

sigil.name: Parakk Pest
sigil.text: A tall terraced metal tavern topped with a huge rat skull.  Meat is questionable and questions are offensive.

sigil.name: Bottle and Jug
sigil.text: A tavern with a round tower and a tall arched door.  Made of black granite and features nightly entertainment combat.

sigil.name: Grease Pit
sigil.text: A wide ring-shaped pit at the edge of the district.  Packed tightly with food stalls, a wide range of foods and beverages are available around a central table area.

sigil.name: Horus's House
sigil.text: A modest house on a straight row, east of the Mortuary.

sigil.name: Cask Family HQ
sigil.text: Through twisting hallways, a back room of the Smoldering Corpse Bar.

sigil.name: Ninefold Tenement
sigil.text: Taking over a collapsed tenement in a courtyard on the Ditch's east bank, at the edge of the Night Market.

sigil.name: Rusted Bell hangout
sigil.text: A hangout tucked away in the basement of the Bottle and Jug.  Only accessible through an alley entrance.

sigil.name: Gray Ledger
sigil.text: A clean, tidy counting house, odd for the Hive, tucked between a patched-up chandler and a small home.

sigil.name: Certified Fishing Circle of the Ditch
sigil.text: The only credentialed fishing spot in all of Sigil. Catch of the day: Left Boot. Rods for rent. Bait for sale. Regulars welcome.

sigil.name: Hall of Records
sigil.text: A colossal, ringed, geometric, bureaucratic monolith of towers where the city's records are kept.

sigil.name: Hall of Speakers
sigil.text: A tiered, rounded hall of green and gold where politics and public speaking take place.  The self-proclaimed center of the political multiverse.

sigil.name: Civic Festhall
sigil.text: A grand hall of banners and spires made of hundreds of materials gathered from places unknown.  Shades of colors clash bizarrely yet it is well built.  The central location of culture.

sigil.name: Hall of Information
sigil.text: A domed hall of records and appointments, with a bright blue roof, made of white marble and gray slate.

sigil.name: Tower Sorcerous
sigil.text: A tall, thorny spire standing alone above the rooftops with no windows and no doors.  The home of all wizardly knowledge that its allies have collected.

sigil.name: Tea Street Transit
sigil.text: A pale-stone flat-wide building with a very large stable, on a quiet street.  The hub of the personal transportation service in Sigil.  Those bulbous onion shaped, pony drawn carriages are based here.

sigil.name: Planar Trade Consortium
sigil.text: A broad pale-stone building with a brass plaque beside every one of its many doors. The bureaucracy is evident inside.

sigil.name: Great Gymnasium
sigil.text: A sprawling black marble complex veined in red and gold, with red-roofed wings around public baths, meditation halls, and training grounds.

sigil.name: Great Bazaar
sigil.text: An open-air market of cramped stalls, carts, ramshackle structures, and tents, where almost anything can be bought or sold.

sigil.name: Planar Energy Cooperative
sigil.text: A tall, narrow tower with a clock face and a needle spire.  Glowing lines race up the side of the building to the top at regular intervals.

sigil.name: Bank of Abbathor Inc.
sigil.text: A heavy dwarven-built stone bank with a tall clock tower and rows of lit windows, guarded by a giant gemstone golem at its entrance.

sigil.name: Institute for Intellectual Excellence
sigil.text: A tall, many-spired hall of study where scholars lecture and argue.  The geometry of the building confuses your eyes, as it doesn't seem right.

sigil.name: Gastrognome
sigil.text: A barrel-roofed restaurant with a small side tower.  Obviously once copper in color, the verdigris is evident by the streaks of green.

sigil.name: Flame Pits
sigil.text: An open arched bathhouse made for guests with unusual needs, from open pools of lava and mud pits to water of untouched purity.

sigil.name: Everything Unexpected
sigil.text: A candy and sweet shop that will sell boomberries, carceni fireballs, Mount Celestia Candy Floss, and even Every Flavored Water from the Elemental Plane of Water.

sigil.name: Tower of Light and Confusion
sigil.text: Need your noggin noodled, senses scrambled, this thin multistoried tower is the place to be.  Mirrored mazes that will put the Lady to shame.  Light shows that will leave you in wonder.

sigil.name: Xaos Kollage
sigil.text: This courtyard has a central tower with wrap around side buildings.  Once a college for learning, now a place for entertainment.  Hear the strings, percussion, and woodwinds of the chaosmen as they express their art.

sigil.name: Screaming Tower
sigil.text: A twisted, hollow tower that wails whenever a great gust of wind blows through it, every once in a while, generating its own.

sigil.name: Palace of the Jester
sigil.text: A ridiculously huge hall that sits mostly empty except on the rare occasions where the richest and most powerful of Sigil meet under an enforced peace.

sigil.name: High-Up
sigil.text: A fashion boutique that will cater to your every whim.  Wine while you wait, measure while you muse, cheese while you choose.

sigil.name: Rule of Four
sigil.text: An elaborate building of exquisitely carved stone that hosts an alehouse, feasthall, bathhouse and steamroom all under one roof.  Here you'll find yourself relaxing into any activity.

sigil.name: Sign of the Drunken Mage
sigil.text: A tavern on Alehouse Row, marked by a sign of a mage swaying drunk.  A resting place, famous for its magic users, a barrier marks every person without a spark of magic who walks through the door, for insult.

sigil.name: Dirk and Firkin Tavern
sigil.text: A tavern whose sign shows a dagger and a small cask.  The most normal tavern on Alehouse Row, which makes it one of the most popular.

sigil.name: Spireward Trading Co.
sigil.text: A multistoried building with well dressed individuals walking in and out of it.  The company seems to have many offices beyond just this one.

sigil.name: The Friendly Fiend
sigil.text: A cramped shop of magical trinkets, kept by a yugoloth.  You need it, it might be here.

sigil.name: The Golden Bell Pawnshop
sigil.text: A pawnshop that will take almost anything.  Marked by a golden bell over the door.

sigil.name: Hands of Time Clockwork Shop
sigil.text: A shop that is itself a shifting mechanical sculpture with ticking gears and a clock that rings on every hour.  Every need of a mechanical nature will be fulfilled here.

sigil.name: Giltspur's Auction Block
sigil.text: A high-roofed, one-room auction house where anything may be sold to the highest bidder.  Everything above board.

sigil.name: Boneyard Pond
sigil.text: A still pond with floating refuse, perhaps a corpse, and someone on the shore trying to find a drink.

sigil.name: Scratch Wall
sigil.text: A wall covered in scratched messages. Press a copper to it and it will take your words for others to read.

sigil.name: Silverahm Virlikot's billiard parlor
sigil.text: A billiard parlor.

sigil.name: Lazz School of Vivid Unpleasantness
sigil.text: An art school and salon for jarring, cacophonous and controversial performances.

sigil.name: Streetsweeper's Yard
sigil.text: A junkyard where the dabus pile what the streets have swept up.  With a ‘donation’ they will allow a search without question.

sigil.name: The Other Place Spa
sigil.text: The open-court, luxurious spa for only the well-appointed across the street from the Great Gymnasium.  Names are checked at the door.

sigil.name: Wooly Cupgrass' Laboratory
sigil.text: An alchemist's laboratory whose owner can name almost any liquid brought through the door.  The building is metal, cylindrical, and closed off to any outsider except by invitation.

sigil.name: Jandor's Music Boxes
sigil.text: A tidy shop of music boxes big and small.  Each playing its own tune.  Each on its own mismatched shelf.

sigil.name: Divinities Clockwork Pet Shop
sigil.text: A shop of clockwork animals both wind-up and magically imbued and perhaps somewhere in between.  The display shows a clockwork dog fetching a bone.

sigil.name: S.I.G.I.S.
sigil.text: Cullers wanted.  Contact the Editor in Chief, Nathaniel Rever.

sigil.name: Jinggor's Curios
sigil.text: A tiny store cramped between one home and another store.  This junk shop is stocked end to end with odds and ends from the Astral Sea.  There is room enough for one customer.

sigil.name: Vaugle, Vaugle, Drakalar, and Spittle Bookkeepers
sigil.text: This three-story bookkeeping firm and store specializes in record storage and book reselling.  Nothing new is sold here.

sigil.name: Theatre Broulliard
sigil.text: A tall flowered silver arch portal standing alone in a large alley that leads directly to the theater.

sigil.name: Magnum Opus' Musee
sigil.text: A two story arcane museum devoted to Planar archeology.  Admission is 3 silver per visit.

sigil.name: Zadara's Tower
sigil.text: A tower of pale stone with a door twice the size as a normal door that seems to have never opened.

sigil.name: St. Azreal's Church
sigil.text: A church which was once a reputable theater but there is noticeable wear.  A sign in front shows that the building is multipurpose including worship services, Leaping Friends Community Players, Gambling Addicts Anonymous, Journeyman Adventurers Beginning Courses, and Sewers and Spectres Club.

sigil.name: Bibbins Bags
sigil.text: A magical bag shop minor in size, for all of your storage solutions. Its sign reads: Best bags in the berg.

sigil.name: Ziff and Hamilly's Toys
sigil.text: A large toy store.  The front display has the largest glazed window that you have ever seen.

sigil.name: Wrangle, Wrangle, Wrangle, Wrangle, Wrangle, Wrangle, Wrangle, and Pinch, Att. at Law
sigil.text: A law office with a long painted sign of eight names.  The door has a plaque with the name and side of the office is painted with ‘injured in a cart accident, one visit that’s all.’

sigil.name: Granny Nettle
sigil.text: A cottage on the corner that looks like it could fall apart at any time, but a closer look shows that the wood is well made, the nails well placed, and the roof well thatched.

sigil.name: Portal to Korvash
sigil.text: A dead-end alley with a bare metal-plated wall at the far end, worn with cart ruts.  Horus's contract run between Korvash and New Haven passes through here.
